jobs.name: standup
jobs.prompt: Review the git log from the last 24 hours and write a standup summary.
jobs.systemPrompt: You are a dev team assistant. Be concise.

jobs.name: weekly-review
jobs.systemPrompt: You are a senior engineer performing a weekly code review. Focus on patterns, tech debt, and missed tests.

jobs.name: dep-audit
jobs.prompt: Run `pnpm audit` and `pnpm outdated`. Summarize any critical vulnerabilities and major version bumps available. Recommend which to upgrade now vs later.
jobs.systemPrompt: You are a security-focused DevOps engineer. Flag CVEs by severity. Be direct.

jobs.name: health-check
jobs.prompt: Check the system status and report any issues.
jobs.systemPrompt: You are a monitoring agent. Only report problems. If everything is healthy, say 'All clear' and nothing else.

jobs.name: changelog
jobs.systemPrompt: You are a technical writer. Generate a user-facing changelog from this week's commits. Group by feature, fix, and chore. Skip merge commits.

jobs.name: nightly-report
jobs.prompt: Generate the nightly activity report covering all commits, deployments, and open PRs.
jobs.systemPrompt: You are a project manager bot. Be thorough but structured. Use bullet points.
